article.title: Hindi to English: Work context sentence
article.description: Hindi: 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है।' English: 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.' Teaching point: 'करना है' (have to do) is obligation, translated with 'have to' not 'must' here since it's a deadline-driven task obligation, not a personal rule.
article.content: Hindi: 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है।' English: 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.' Teaching point: 'करना है' (have to do) is obligation, translated with 'have to' not 'must' here since it's a deadline-driven task obligation, not a personal rule.

generated.caption:
Got a work project due soon? ⏰ To talk about a deadline-driven task in English, use "have to." It shows an obligation you need to complete.

For example: "I have to finish this project by tomorrow." This is better than 'must' for external tasks!

Save this tip and follow @theenglishvault for daily lessons!
generated.script: Ye 'mujhe karna hai' ko translate karte hue aksar 'must' aur 'have to' mein confusion hota hai na? Dekho, jab aapko koi kaam karna *hai*, matlab it's an obligation, especially deadline-driven, tab hum use karte hain **have to**. 'Must' thoda personal rule jaisa ho jaata hai. Toh is sentence, 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है', ki correct translation hai 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow'. Ab samajh aaya? Deadline waale obligations ke liye, hamesha use karo 'have to'. Comment mein batao aapko ye pehle pata tha ya nahi! Aur aise hi English tips ke liye follow karo The English Vault!

slides.body: When translating the Hindi sentence 'मुझे यह प्रोजेक्ट कल तक पूरा करना है', the correct English equivalent is 'I have to finish this project by tomorrow.' The phrase 'करना है' (have to do) indicates an obligation, specifically one driven by an external deadline or requirement. In such cases, 'have to' is the appropriate choice in English, rather than 'must.' While 'must' also expresses obligation, it often implies a personal rule or a strong necessity from the speaker's perspective, whereas 'have to' is perfect for tasks or duties imposed by circumstances or others.
slides.hindiSummary: किसी काम को समय-सीमा में पूरा करने की बाध्यता के लिए 'have to' का इस्तेमाल होता है, न कि 'must' का।
